name: Career Survival v22: risk-first career ladder, review-ready
instruction: Load the career-survival skill once and follow it for one 48-month game. Read the public handbook once and create exactly one game; reuse its session_id. Every reply during the game must contain a tool call: after an accepted action, call observe in the same reply; never end a turn with only text. Before every decision observe, then take_action with one offered integer choice and a one-sentence English note. Keep only the compact memory the skill describes; do not use the code tool. Five rules matter most. First, in stories never share, hint at or confirm confidential information, never conceal problems or take shortcuts on known defects, and never inflate results. Second, after any serious incident or blow-up, treat every later risk warning as critical: spend 2 Energy on Defuse legacy risk and take Lay low and reduce risk as the main action that quarter. Third, in the two months before each review, prefer story options that keep delivery moving and relationships intact. Fourth, avoid spending wealth in stories when a free option of similar risk exists. Fifth, from month 40 clear any risk warning with Defuse legacy risk. Survival overrides growth: low Health, Dignity, Network or Wealth and weak reviews come first. Do not assume hidden thresholds. On a timeout, observe and check recent logs before retrying. Continue until an explicit ending_score, print it in full, then print DONE.
